# Resource: tfe_project_settings

Manages project settings.

Primarily, this resource allows setting default execution mode and agent pool for all workspaces within a project. When not specified, the organization defaults will be used.

-> **Note:** Requires Terraform CLI version 1.0 and later.

## Example Usage

```python
import constructs as constructs
import cdktf as cdktf
# Provider bindings are generated by running cdktf get.
# See https://cdk.tf/provider-generation for more details.
import ...gen.providers.tfe as tfe
class MyConvertedCode(cdktf.TerraformStack):
    def __init__(self, scope, name):
        super().__init__(scope, name)
        tfe_organization_test = tfe.organization.Organization(self, "test",
            email="admin@company.com",
            name="my-org-name"
        )
        tfe_project_my_project = tfe.project.Project(self, "my_project",
            name="my-project",
            organization=cdktf.Token.as_string(tfe_organization_test.name)
        )
        tfe_agent_pool_my_agents = tfe.agent_pool.AgentPool(self, "my_agents",
            name="my-agent-pool",
            organization=cdktf.Token.as_string(tfe_organization_test.name)
        )
        tfe.organization_default_settings.OrganizationDefaultSettings(self, "org_default",
            default_agent_pool_id=cdktf.Token.as_string(tfe_agent_pool_my_agents.id),
            default_execution_mode="agent",
            organization=cdktf.Token.as_string(tfe_organization_test.name)
        )
        tfe.project_settings.ProjectSettings(self, "my_project_settings",
            default_agent_pool_id=cdktf.Token.as_string(tfe_agent_pool_my_agents.id),
            default_execution_mode="agent",
            project_id=cdktf.Token.as_string(tfe_project_my_project.id)
        )
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `project_id` (String) The ID of the project to manage settings for.

### Optional

- `default_agent_pool_id` (String) The ID of an agent pool to assign to the project. Requires `default_execution_mode` to be set to `agent`. This value must not be provided if `default_execution_mode` is set to any other value.
- `default_execution_mode` (String) Which [execution mode](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cloud-docs/workspaces/settings#execution-mode) to use as the default for all workspaces in the project. Valid values are `remote`, `local` or `agent`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Service-generated identifier for the resource.
- `overwrites` (Attributes) Can be used to check whether a setting is currently inheriting its value from the organization or is being overwritten. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--overwrites))

<a id="nestedatt--overwrites"></a>
### Nested Schema for `overwrites`

Read-Only:

- `default_agent_pool_id` (Boolean) Set to `true` if the default agent pool of the project is being determined by the setting on the project itself. It will be `false` if the agent pool is inherited from another resource (e.g. the organization's default agent pool).
- `default_execution_mode` (Boolean) Set to `true` if the default execution mode of the project is being determined by the setting on the project itself. It will be `false` if the execution mode is inherited from another resource (e.g. the organization's default execution mode).




## Import

Resource tfe_project_settings can be imported in the following format: 

```shell
# via <PROJECT ID>
terraform import tfe_project_settings.my_project_settings prj-F1NpdVBuCF3xc5R
```
